serverInfo.title: Carpenterwala Pan-India Home Services, AI Pro Onboarding & Customer Portal
serverInfo.description: Carpenterwala Pan-India Home Improvement Marketplace, 0% Commission AI Pro Onboarding, and Customer/Pro OAuth 2.1 self-service portals.

scopes.customer: Access appliance warranties and repair bookings
scopes.pro: Access assigned leads and job management

authentication.notes: Public discovery and marketplace inquiry tools require no authentication. Customer and Pro authenticated tools require OAuth 2.1 Authorization Code grant with PKCE (S256) via mobile OTP.
